css: .t-page{background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font-family:var(--font);padding:var(--inset)}.sc-frame{position:relative;height:100%;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;text-align:center;padding:.45in .4in}.border-thin .sc-frame{border:var(--borderWidth) solid var(--borderColor)}.border-double .sc-frame{border:calc(var(--borderWidth) * 2.5) double var(--borderColor)}.border-corners .sc-frame i{position:absolute;width:.5in;height:.5in;border:var(--borderWidth) solid var(--borderColor)}.sc-frame i{display:none}.border-corners .sc-frame i{display:block}.c1{top:0;left:0;border-right:0!important;border-bottom:0!important}.c2{top:0;right:0;border-left:0!important;border-bottom:0!important}.c3{bottom:0;left:0;border-right:0!important;border-top:0!important}.c4{bottom:0;right:0;border-left:0!important;border-top:0!important}.sc-orn{display:block;color:var(--borderColor);font-size:20pt;margin-bottom:.15in}.ornament-leaf .sc-orn::before{content:'❦'}.ornament-star .sc-orn::before{content:'✦'}.ornament-cross .sc-orn::before{content:'✝'}.sc-verse{font-size:var(--size);line-height:1.35;margin:0 0 .2in;font-style:italic}.sc-ref{font-size:12pt;letter-spacing:.08em;margin:0;color:var(--borderColor)}.sc-cap{position:absolute;bottom:.2in;left:0;right:0;font-size:9pt;margin:0;opacity:.75}
